messages:
harper: ran rwd-v9-int4b through the onboarding harness (mixed slices n=7k). TL;DR: p50 -20%, p95 -25% on staging GPUs, cost per-token approx -35%, but a persistent fidelity delta on multi-doc synthesis and citation accuracy.

miguel: numbers and CI?

harper: hallucination proxy: baseline rwd-v9-fp16=2.4% (CI +/-0.4%) -> v9-int4b=4.7% (CI +/-0.45%) => abs_delta ~2.3% (CI LB ~1.85%). agreement with baseline ranking 90.8%.

june: that gap is larger than our usual soft gate. What slices concentrate the regression?

harper: mostly "multi-doc synthesis", "timeline construction" and chaining instructions. Short Q/A and single-doc extract are near parity.

eval-bot: upload: //internal/snapshots/1775000000/v9-int4b-regressions.log. summary published to /reports/onboard/1775000000.

miguel: given the CI LB > 1.0%, auto-fallback would trigger on our current canary config. propose a probationary canary instead of immediate promote: small window + extended vetting.

june: propose a probationary gate: 0.05% traffic for 72h with shadowing + rerank fallback. metrics: hallucination_abs_delta_threshold=1.2%, agreement_min=93%, p95_latency_delta_max=60ms, avg_logprob_delta soft signal. if CI lower bound > 1.2% -> immediate rollback. Also require two consecutive 24h windows within the 72h where hall_abs_delta < 0.8% to allow any step-up.

harper: drafting gate config (working):
```json
{
  "mode": "probationary",
  "target_pct": 0.05,
  "duration_hours": 72,
  "checks": {
    "hallucination_abs_delta_pct": 1.2,
    "agreement_pct": 93,
    "p95_latency_ms_delta": 60,
    "avg_logprob_delta": "soft"
  },
  "auto_fallback": true,
  "fallback_policy": "route-to-baseline-or-rerank",
  "hysteresis": {
    "consecutive_windows_required": 2,
    "window_hours": 24,
    "promotion_delta_target": 0.8
  },
  "monitoring_hooks": ["eval-bot/report","trace-ingest","ptx-bot/health"]
}
```

miguel: I like the probationary framing. Slight tweak: make hallucination threshold 1.0% for user-facing slices and 1.5% for internal-only slices. Also add a fast-fail rule: if hallucination CI LB > 2.0% at any point -> emergency rollback.

june: good point. I'll add per-slice thresholds and the fast-fail rule. Also suggest running two concurrent shadows: (A) pure int4b, (B) hybrid-int4b-body-fp16 to see if body precision mitigates drift.

harper: plan: cancel the scheduled 10% soft-promote, launch probationary 0.05% canary with shadow + rerank fallback and parallel hybrid shadow. create ticket RL-5000 and attach artifacts.

ops-bot: RL-5000 created (harper). scheduled canary start 2025-06-01T08:00Z @0.05% with shadowing and rerank hooks.

eval-bot: initial snapshot (n=7000) -> hall_est_v9_int4b=4.7% +/-0.45%, baseline=2.4% +/-0.4%. abs_delta=2.3% (LB 1.85%). full diff and sample hits at //internal/snapshots/1775000000/v9-int4b-diff.log

miguel: with that CI LB > 1.2% we expect the probationary gate to trigger auto-fallback when it runs. but we still want the hybrid experiment. if hybrid closes delta < 0.9% and agreement > 94% we can consider staged increase after hysteresis windows.

june: add monitoring: emit per-slice CI lower bounds to the ops channel and trigger an on-call page if fast-fail rule trips. include the rollback snippet in the ticket: `redwood rollout cancel --id RL-5000 && redwood route set default rwd-v9-fp16 && redwood alert create --level incident --tag canary-halluc`.

harper: will attach the rollback playbook and kernel trace notes (attention-kernel path differences) to RL-5000. ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of the traces. :mag_right:

ptx-bot: note: please ensure GPU kernel telemetry included in telemetry payload or kernel traces will be truncated.

miguel: thanks all. we're holding the 10% promote and moving forward with probationary + hybrid shadows. reconvene after 48h of data collection or earlier if fast-fail triggers. :white_check_mark:
